reason: Slipper-shaped (calceolate) is a specific pouch shape, as in a lip or labellum. Saccate is a general pouch or bag.
Drops 'sparsely'. The density of the hairs is lost, and sparsely hirsute is not the same as hirsute.
'Unclear' means indistinct. That fits inconspicuous only for features such as veins or markings.
Without caruncle means the caruncle is absent.
The rule is already restricted to corolla. Without spurs means the corolla spur is absent.
Crest-like is cristate, which is crested.
Fine-meshed means a net-like pattern with small meshes. The mesh size is a minor loss.
Drops 'pale'. This is a lighter shade of chestnut brown, not chestnut.
Lobate is a variant spelling of lobed, so pinnately lobate means pinnately lobed.
Setulose means with small bristles, which is not the same as pubescent. The target loses the setulose part. Glandular-pubescent is a different hair type.
Mealy keeps the powdery texture but drops the white colour. White and powdery are two qualities.
Equally long is equal in length. Equal is equal in size, which is broader.
Mid-veined means having a midvein.
Nerveless usually means no visible veins in a leaf-like part. A vascular bundle is a different, internal structure. It is correct only if the leaf vein is meant.
Olive-shaped is a 3-D ovoid or ellipsoid form, not the 2-D elliptic outline. I found no good target.
Oval is a common botanical word for broadly elliptic.
Biarticulated means two-jointed. The number of joints is lost.
Pentahedral means five-faced and is 3-D. Pentagonal is a 2-D five-sided outline.
Bi- means twice pinnatisect. The double division is lost.
Drops 'short'. Short-rhombic is a proportion of the rhomboid shape.
Drops 'broadly', the degree of leaf-likeness.
The prefix e- means without, so esinuose means without sinuses, i.e. not sinuous.
Lax walled means loose or flaccid walls, not thin walls. No thickness is stated.
Nondecurrent means not decurrent.
'Not separating' is ambiguous. It can mean not splitting or not dehiscing, or not falling off. It does not clearly mean non-deciduous.
Rhizoidiferous means bearing rhizoids.
The strength belongs to the stem. Robust on the plant loses the bearer.
The quality is about the lateral walls, not the whole part. The bearer is lost.
Arcuate is one kind of curve, so not arcuate does not mean not curved. The part may still be curved in another way.
Not spurred is stated for different parts. The rule is correct only when the part is the corolla or a petal. A calyx or sepal spur is a different structure.
Piliform means hair-like, which is finer than the thread-like filiform.
Tuberized means swollen like a tuber, which is tuberous.
Bracteoliform means shaped like a bracteole, a small bract. Bract-like is close enough.
Fused to the apex of another part is adnation, not connation. Connate means fused with like parts, and the attachment point is lost.
Non-articulated means not jointed.
Repliable means able to be folded back. It is not the same as folded.
Curvilinear means following curved lines, which is curved.
Domatia-bearing means domatia are present.
Fauve means tawny, a yellowish brown.
Translucent dots are often glands but are not always so. The gland meaning is added.
Homomorphous means all of one form. Not dimorphic also allows three or more forms.
Lenticel-free means no lenticels.
Unguiculate means clawed, so not unguiculate means not clawed.
Asperulate means slightly rough, which is close to scabrous.
Intraxylary phloem is a synonym of internal phloem in the PO lexicon.
Scarcely apparent means barely visible, which is inconspicuous.
Subconic means almost conical, a normal approximation.
Non-overlapping means not imbricate.
Twin means two together, which is paired.
Veinlet is a synonym of higher order leaf vein, so without included veinlets means these are absent.
